articles.title: Bitcoin tops $77,000 as best week since 2023 pulls altcoins along for the ride
articles.snippet: BTC has gained 24% since Monday and reached the level implied by its inverse head-and-shoulders break, with shorts still taking a contrarian position.

articles.title: Strategy sits on $1.4 billion profit on bitcoin holdings as price surges
articles.snippet: Strategy’s common stock rose 10% in Friday pre-market trading to $120, the highest level in two months.

articles.title: Ripple backs an RLUSD credit fund amid XRP's best week in months
articles.snippet: Clearpool and Cicada Partners are building an institutional lending product using RLUSD, though the XRP Ledger features underpinning it are still awaiting activation.

articles.title: Bitcoin breaks above 200-day moving average for first time since November
articles.snippet: The BTC price reclaimed its 200-day moving average for the first time in nine months as its rally gained momentum after the US Treasury expanded its bond buybacks.

articles.title: Bitcoin price reaches $72.5K as US issues ‘Economic D-Day’ threat to Iran
articles.snippet: Bitcoin saw new multimonth highs above $72,500 even as US stocks cooled amid US threats of “economic warfare” with Iran.
